llm_summary: Summary: The overall sentiment toward the Cocokind Resurrection Polypeptide Cream is mixed, with users frequently praising its hydrating, dewy finish and effective peptide-rich formula as an affordable alternative to high-end moisturizers. However, while some appreciate its texture, others report it lacks sufficient longevity for very dry skin or can cause breakouts and irritation for those with sensitive, acne-prone complexions.
